meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多步长任务有条不紊地分步推进并自动保存进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能体在处理需要几十步的复杂任务时容易半途丢失进度。
copy.tagline_en: Keep multi-step tasks on track with saved plans and progress.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent often loses track during long multi-step work.

howto.what: Claude 会把任务计划、研究心得和进度分别写入磁盘上的 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md；每次回应前会读取当前计划，操作后提示更新进度，对话被清空后也能靠这些文件接着干。
howto.when: 当你要求规划、拆解或组织某个多步骤项目或研究任务，或该工作预计要 5 次以上工具调用时；对话被清空后也会尝试从计划文件恢复。

say.text: 帮我为这个课题写一份 task_plan.md，分阶段列步骤。
say.note: Claude 会创建计划文件并开始分步执行。

say.text: 把刚才的发现补充到 findings.md 里。
say.note: 研究心得会被持续记录到磁盘文件。

say.text: 我清空了对话，读 task_plan.md 和 progress.md 继续。
say.note: Claude 会读取计划与进度后恢复工作。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk. It reads the current plan before responding, reminds you to update progress after actions, and can resume work after a cleared conversation.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project or research task, or any work needing 5+ tool calls; after /clear it also tries to recover from saved plan files.

say_en.text: Write a task_plan.md for this project with phases.
say_en.note: Claude will create the plan and follow it.

say_en.text: Add what we just learned to findings.md.
say_en.note: Keeps discoveries in a disk file.

say_en.text: I cleared the conversation—read task_plan.md and progress.md and continue.
say_en.note: Resumes from the saved plan and progress.
